name: JD Woodworking
old_description: A true devotion to the craft stems from an intense satisfaction of turning conception into reality. I founded JDWOODWORKING in 2000 as a platform to showcase and sell quality handmade products. Sometimes in today’s modern world we can forget the beauty in the natural, beautiful, and handmade. Get in touch to start your project today.
about:
JD Woodworking operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The founder, who is not named in public materials, describes a lifelong practice of designing, manufacturing, building, and repairing wood items. The business traces its origins to 2000 when the founder launched JDWOODWORKING as a platform to showcase handmade products, though the current business entity is noted as starting in 2016.

The shop produces a range of handcrafted wood goods including cutting boards (end-grain, personalized, and striped designs in black walnut, cherry, and maple), flags and wall decor, holiday decorations, and offers custom furniture repair services. Work is characterized as original, built to last, and reliant on quality materials, attention to detail, and patience. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are disclosed.

The company sells directly to individual customers through its website, offering made-to-order pieces and stock items such as serving boards and state-shaped flags. There is no mention of industrial or commercial clients; the focus appears to be on consumer home goods and repair work.

The founder cites integrity, reliability, and professionalism as guiding principles, emphasizing a devotion to craft and the satisfaction of turning conception into reality. The business was started to counter a modern tendency to overlook the beauty of natural, handmade objects.
